name: render_undo_roundtrip
description: RU-1 and RU-1b: Undo and Redo of render edits, on RD-1 and RD-1b. A Pass Editor edit (present draws the fixture's inverting fragment, which the viewport shows) is taken back with the Frame Plan's Undo -- the picture and get_render_authoring_context are what they were -- and put again with its Redo. Decompose into loop is taken back with Edit > Undo Render Edit (the Frame Plan draws the material pass again, the graph holds no loop), put again with Redo, and taken back once more. The Pass Editor's New pass on this graph root is the Graph's (GL-5f): a render.fullscreen in the graph's nodes and no fragment file; the Graph tab's Undo takes it back (and not a render edit: present keeps its fragment), its Redo puts it again and the Frame Plan draws it. Last, a Pass Editor edit followed by moving present on the Frame Plan (which rewrites the root's layout) is still undone, and the placement stays. GL-5c: present's fragment is picked in the Graph's detail column, where a double-click on present opens it. (Before GL-5f, New pass wrote a managed fragment with add_authored_pass and RU-1b's Undo and Redo took the file away and wrote it back; on a graph root no pass is added that way any more.)
